title: Generalized adverse-response candidate manifest and frozen VALIDATION protocol
description: Issue #421 contract. One file covers the two frozen artifacts: CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json is a candidateManifest and FROZEN_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL.json is a frozenProtocol. Both are authored and hashed before the fenced VALIDATION admission evaluation reads a single VALIDATION row. The protocol registers the minimum product coverage (>= 0.50), the non-inferiority rule, the maximum allowed calibration and the raise-sizing criteria, and every threshold is immutable after the freeze.
